authentication_required.title: Authentication Required on API/Listener
authentication_required.description: Whether the monitoring agent's API, management interface, or listener requires authentication (e.g., API key, token, mTLS) before serving requests or accepting connections.

api_network_exposure.title: API/Listener Network Exposure Scope
api_network_exposure.description: The network scope on which the monitoring API or agent listener is bound and reachable — localhost only, internal network, or publicly accessible.

sensitive_operations_exposed.title: Sensitive Operations Exposed via Unauthenticated API
sensitive_operations_exposed.description: Whether the unauthenticated API surface includes sensitive operations such as suppressing alerts, modifying detection thresholds, reading raw telemetry, or administrative controls.

telemetry_transport_tls_enabled.title: Telemetry Transport TLS Enabled
telemetry_transport_tls_enabled.description: Whether TLS/SSL encryption is enabled for telemetry and alert payload transmission to aggregators or SIEM systems.

telemetry_destination_protocol.title: Telemetry Destination Protocol
telemetry_destination_protocol.description: The network protocol used when transmitting telemetry data and alerts to the aggregator or SIEM endpoint.

ca_certificate_validation_enforced.title: CA Certificate Validation Enforced
ca_certificate_validation_enforced.description: Whether the monitoring component enforces CA certificate validation when establishing TLS connections to aggregators or SIEM systems, preventing connections to endpoints with invalid or self-signed certificates that are not trusted.

agent_process_account.title: Agent Process Account
agent_process_account.description: The operating system account under which the monitoring agent process runs.

least_privilege_policy_enforced.title: Least Privilege Policy Enforced
least_privilege_policy_enforced.description: Whether the agent's account permissions have been explicitly scoped to only the read access required for its monitored subsystems (e.g., via sudoers rules, capability dropping, SELinux/AppArmor profile, or Windows privilege stripping).

process_isolation_enabled.title: Process Isolation Enabled
process_isolation_enabled.description: Whether the agent process is confined by a sandbox mechanism such as a seccomp profile, SELinux/AppArmor mandatory access control policy, or Windows Job Object that limits the blast radius even if running as a privileged account.

credential_source.title: Credential Source
credential_source.description: Indicates how credentials for alerting backends or databases are supplied to the monitoring service.

config_file_world_readable.title: Configuration File World-Readable
config_file_world_readable.description: Whether the configuration file containing credentials is readable by all users on the system (permissions include o+r), applicable to both credential exposure and secrets storage contexts.

default_credentials_changed.title: Default Credentials Changed
default_credentials_changed.description: Whether default vendor-supplied credentials have been changed from their out-of-box values for all connected backends.

config_file_world_writable.title: Alert Config File is World-Writable
config_file_world_writable.description: Whether alert threshold, detection rule, or suppression list configuration files have world-writable permissions, allowing any local user to modify them.

config_directory_world_writable.title: Alert Config Parent Directory is World-Writable
config_directory_world_writable.description: Whether the directory containing alert/detection configuration files is world-writable, allowing a local attacker to replace or add configuration files even if individual files have correct permissions.

config_owner_matches_service_account.title: Config File Owner Matches Dedicated Service Account
config_owner_matches_service_account.description: Whether the alert/detection configuration files are owned by the designated service account (not root or a generic user), ensuring ownership-based access control is correctly applied.

config_integrity_monitoring_enabled.title: File Integrity Monitoring Enabled for Alert Configs
config_integrity_monitoring_enabled.description: Whether a file integrity monitoring (FIM) solution is configured to detect unauthorized changes to alert threshold and detection rule configuration files.

agent_version_has_known_cve.title: Agent Version Has Known CVE
agent_version_has_known_cve.description: Indicates whether the installed monitoring agent version (including bundled libraries) has one or more publicly disclosed CVEs that have not been patched.

days_since_last_patch.title: Days Since Last Agent Patch
days_since_last_patch.description: Number of days elapsed since the monitoring agent or its dependencies were last updated or patched.

agent_network_interface_exposed.title: Agent Network Interface Exposed
agent_network_interface_exposed.description: Indicates whether the monitoring agent listens on a network interface reachable from outside the local host (i.e., binds to a non-loopback address), increasing the attack surface for exploiting known CVEs.

listener_bind_address.title: Listener Bind Address
listener_bind_address.description: The IP address the monitoring agent listener is bound to. Binding to 0.0.0.0 exposes the service on all network interfaces including untrusted ones.

network_policy_restricts_agent_port.title: Network Policy Restricts Agent Port
network_policy_restricts_agent_port.description: Whether a firewall rule, network policy, or security group explicitly restricts inbound access to the agent listener port to trusted sources only.

config_change_audit_logging_enabled.title: Config Change Audit Logging Enabled
config_change_audit_logging_enabled.description: Whether the monitoring/alerting system logs changes to detection rules, alert configurations, and suppression settings to an audit trail.

audit_log_fields_captured.title: Audit Log Fields Captured
audit_log_fields_captured.description: List of fields recorded in audit log entries for config/rule changes. Required fields for forensic reconstruction include: user, timestamp, before_value, after_value.

suppression_change_logging_enabled.title: Suppression Rule Change Logging Enabled
suppression_change_logging_enabled.description: Whether changes to alert suppression or silencing settings are specifically captured in audit logs, separate from general config change logging.

secret_storage_method.title: Secret Storage Method
secret_storage_method.description: How credentials (API keys, tokens, passwords) used by the monitoring agent are stored for configuration.

plaintext_secret_patterns_found.title: Plaintext Secret Patterns Found in Config
plaintext_secret_patterns_found.description: Whether static analysis or inspection of the config file reveals credential-like patterns (e.g., api_key, token, password, secret) assigned to literal string values rather than references to a secrets manager or environment variable placeholders.

mutual_tls_enabled.title: Mutual TLS Enabled
mutual_tls_enabled.description: Whether the collector is configured to require and validate a client certificate from the agent (i.e., full mutual TLS is enforced, not just server-side TLS).

collector_client_ca_configured.title: Collector Client CA Certificate Configured
collector_client_ca_configured.description: Whether the collector has a trusted CA certificate configured against which it validates incoming agent client certificates.

tls_mode.title: TLS Authentication Mode
tls_mode.description: The TLS mode in use between agents and the collector, indicating whether authentication is one-way (server only), mutual, or disabled entirely.

notification_channel_count.title: Notification Channel Count
notification_channel_count.description: The number of distinct alert notification channels (e.g., email, PagerDuty, Slack, webhook) configured for the monitoring system.

failover_channel_configured.title: Failover Channel Configured
failover_channel_configured.description: Whether a secondary or fallback notification channel is explicitly configured to activate when the primary channel fails or is unreachable.

alert_delivery_health_check_enabled.title: Alert Delivery Health Check Enabled
alert_delivery_health_check_enabled.description: Whether a watchdog or dead-man's-switch alert is configured to detect silent failures in the alert pipeline itself (e.g., a continuously firing test alert that would surface if alerting breaks).

alert_management_rbac_enabled.title: Alert Management RBAC Enabled
alert_management_rbac_enabled.description: Indicates whether role-based access control is enforced on the alert management console, restricting alert acknowledgement, closure, and modification to authorized roles only.

minimum_role_required_for_alert_write.title: Minimum Role Required for Alert Write Actions
minimum_role_required_for_alert_write.description: The minimum role level permitted to acknowledge, close, or modify alerts in the alert management console.

exposed_alert_actions.title: Exposed Alert Actions Available to Low-Privilege Users
exposed_alert_actions.description: List of privileged alert actions (e.g., 'acknowledge', 'close', 'modify', 'assign', 'suppress') that are accessible to users below the security operations role.

log_retention_days.title: Log Retention Period (Days)
log_retention_days.description: Number of days monitoring agent logs are retained before deletion or overwrite.

log_rotation_max_size_mb.title: Log Rotation Max File Size (MB)
log_rotation_max_size_mb.description: Maximum log file size in megabytes before rotation is triggered. Very small values cause frequent rotation and rapid evidence overwrite.

log_rotation_kept_files.title: Number of Rotated Log Files Kept
log_rotation_kept_files.description: How many rotated log file generations are kept on disk before the oldest is deleted.

logs_shipped_to_external_sink.title: Logs Shipped to External/Centralized Sink
logs_shipped_to_external_sink.description: Whether monitoring agent logs are forwarded to a centralized or external log management system (e.g., SIEM, cloud logging service) before local rotation.

webhook_url_validation_enforced.title: Webhook URL Validation Enforced
webhook_url_validation_enforced.description: Whether the alert routing configuration enforces format validation or allowlisting on external webhook URLs and hostnames before use.

external_config_write_access_restricted.title: External Configuration Write Access Restricted
external_config_write_access_restricted.description: Whether write access to the alert routing configuration (e.g., alertmanager config file, API endpoint) is restricted to authorized principals only.

webhook_url_allowlist_configured.title: Webhook URL Allowlist Configured
webhook_url_allowlist_configured.description: Whether an explicit allowlist of permitted webhook URL prefixes or domains is configured and enforced for alert routing destinations.
